content:
Maya - Partner Eng: FYI - HealthBank tried to install our marketplace bundle into their air-gapped k8s and hit two blockers: their Azure Managed HSM must do all key unwraps and egress is blocked except to their internal registry. Install fails at bootstrap with KMS AccessDenied. Can SI + infra advise?
Ravi - SI: I can repro. Log snippet: 
```nERROR: kms.unwrap failed: AccessDenied: principal not allowed to unwrapKey
```
Ravi - SI: Also imagePulls fail because registry.redwood.dev is unreachable; they only allow their internal registry host via PrivateLink.
Jules - Solutions: Short-term option: Dedicated Private deployment + BYOK to their AKV via Private Endpoint. Long-term: offer signed marketplace artifacts customers can import into their registry. Need an architecture call.
Sam - Infra: If they block egress we can support a customer-side mirror. We'll need to provide signed images and an attestation report. Also update installer to accept imagePullSecrets for arbitrary registries.
Ivy - Sec: Security needs: (1) service principal with unwrap-only role, (2) attestation that keys are non-exportable in Managed HSM, (3) offline-signed image policy. Provide template for principal and attestation checklist.
ops-bot: Created ticket RW-OPS-6250: "HealthBank AKV HSM + marketplace mirror onboarding" assigned to infra.
Maya - Partner Eng: I'll schedule a 30m sync this afternoon; Ravi please gather AKV resource ID and registry host before the call. Thanks :thumbsup:
